title: Answer: lesions, interoceptive physiology and conserved nuclei

statements.text: The account is checked by lesion cases, by testing for non-synaptic and ephaptic signaling in vagal and brainstem pathways, by studying the conserved brainstem nuclei across species, and by multimodal tasks that probe interoception.

sources.locator: 5(a) interoceptive feelings support the continuity of conscious experience
sources.quote: Multimodal tasks are needed to probe the various dimensions of interoception
they provide a valuable phylogenetic opportunity for studying consciousness
